output.summary: Revenue fell about 30%, matching the peer median of -29% for orchestras that did not move. The orchestra's loss came as a step in 2023-24, when Castellan Hall closed and capacity fell 40%. Single-ticket sales fell 45% against a -9% peer median. Lapsed patrons mainly cite travel to Brightwater. Per-concert sales do not differ with post-1945 content. Core subscribers renew at a stable 85%, and the St. Aldric downtown concerts sold far better. Programming is not shown to be the main cause, and marketing effect is unmeasured. Non-renewal on revenue grounds is unsupported. Present a segmented analysis, separate the artistic review, use the cathedral dates, and add attribution before changing marketing.
